named_subject: an aircraft carrier (a flat deck slab with a stepped hull underneath), seen from above at an angle
action: The flat ship shape stays in place and slowly rotates, its deck going from level with a raised right end to sloping down toward the lower right, while the hull step moves along the bottom edge.
identity_gap: The animated shape uses the same open-box deck, inner deck line, stepped hull underside and broken right-end strokes as the doodle, so it reads as the same drawing.
notes: The rotation of the deck matches the film's turn in frames 9-16, but the film shows the ship approaching bow-first and growing toward the camera, which the drawing does not show; the change at frame 9 (shape shifts left and the top edge flips slope) and frame 11 is a visible jump. The one change that would help most is spreading the turn evenly across frames 8-12 so the deck slope changes gradually instead of in two steps.
